completeness.why: Every bulk action decides inclusion only through isMonthWideCategory (income-in-tracking and hidden/group-hidden rules), setZero's divergence is an explicit includeHidden: true argument, the three average actions share getAverageCategories (whose INNER JOIN carries the orphan-group skip) instead of their own filtering SQL, and both sign inversions go through averageToBudgetAmount.

interface.why: Small, focused helpers with one real parameter (includeHidden) that makes setZero's preserved inconsistency explicit; the orphaned-group difference is preserved via the shared INNER JOIN query and a comment rather than a named option, which is slightly implicit.
